summary: Verified the 502 Bad Gateway fix for the Flask FindMe AI app served via the new supervisor 'findme' program (gunicorn on 0.0.0.0:3000). Frontend-only testing over the public preview URL. All 10 pages + 2 static assets return HTTP 200, pages render styled (dark theme CSS applied), all 5 navbar links route correctly, server-side text search form POST returns 4 result cards with match scores, login with invalid creds shows a flash message, /ai-index renders status cards and the Build/Rebuild AI Index button, /people renders 4 seeded profiles, /dashboard renders metrics, /people/101 profile renders. No console/page errors, no horizontal overflow at 390px mobile width. No backend/app files modified.

issues: The 'Invalid username or password.' flash is rendered with green/success-info styling (green border/text, info icon) instead of an error/danger style - misleading for a failed login
Flash container has no data-testid and no error/alert class, so automated error detection cannot target it (had to read body text)
'Search people' input is very narrow (~195px); placeholder text is truncated to 'Search by name, skill, or loc'

action_items: Optional: style the login failure flash as an error (red) and add data-testid="flash-message" plus a category class to the flash container
Optional: widen the People page search input so the placeholder is not clipped
critical_code_review_comments: Supervisor 'frontend' and 'backend' programs remain in FATAL state (they chdir to non-existent /app/frontend and /app/backend). This is harmless for the preview since 'findme' serves port 3000, but /api/* through the ingress will 502 by design - confirm no future feature depends on /api paths.

Text search for 'machine learning python' returns all 4 seeded profiles with identical-looking low scores (46.4% top match); relevance ranking may be weak/hashed-vector based. Behaviour, not a bug for this fix.
seed_data_creation: None created; used existing demo profiles 101-104
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required; login tested with invalid creds only
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a Flask/Jinja multipage app served by supervisor program 'findme' (gunicorn, port 3000). Use the public preview URL for all navigation. Do NOT test /api/* via public URL (ingress sends /api to stopped port 8001). Useful testids: nav-search/nav-people/nav-dashboard/nav-ai-index/nav-about, text-query-input, search-submit, result-card. Search is a normal form POST to /search. Face search untested (requires image upload); AI index rebuild button click untested.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 502: nothing listened on port 3000 because default supervisor frontend/backend programs failed (missing /app/frontend, /app/backend dirs) for this Flask-only project. Fix (new 'findme' gunicorn program bound to 0.0.0.0:3000 with directory /app/final_project) is verified working - all routes return 200 through the Cloudflare/ingress path.
